description: This file contains definitions, macros, and static functions related to CPU feature detection on ARM Linux systems, specifically for use within the OpenSSL project. It includes functions for parsing CPU info and extracting hardware capabilities.

methods.name: STRING_PIECE_equals
methods.description: Compares a STRING_PIECE with a C string for equality.

methods.name: STRING_PIECE_split
methods.description: Splits a STRING_PIECE at the first occurrence of a separator character.

methods.name: STRING_PIECE_get_delimited
methods.description: Extracts a delimited substring from a STRING_PIECE.

methods.name: STRING_PIECE_trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a STRING_PIECE.

methods.name: extract_cpuinfo_field
methods.description: Extracts a specific field value from CPU info string.

methods.name: has_list_item
methods.description: Checks if a space-separated list contains a specific item.

methods.name: crypto_get_arm_hwcap2_from_cpuinfo
methods.description: Determines ARM hardware capabilities from CPU info string.
